name: Registry of WebMCP tool packages for non-adopting sites

mentions.name: Registry of WebMCP tool packages for non-adopting sites
mentions.description: A registry of packages that add WebMCP tools to websites that have not natively adopted WebMCP. Each package describes tools for a specific site as JSON, and those tools are injected and executed via a browser extension.
mentions.problem: Sites have not adopted WebMCP yet, so there is no native tool support to build on.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a registry for packages that add WebMCP tools to sites that have not adopted WebMCP yet. Each package describes tools for a specific site as json and those tools are injected and executed using a browser extension.
